title: Fundraising: Run a Donation Campaign With Tax Receipts | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A donation is not a sale at a fixed price: each donor decides how much to give, often in honor or in memory of someone, and wants a receipt for their taxes. The CrestApps Fundraising module runs a campaign on your Orchard Core site, with suggested amounts, a goal, progress shown on the page, and a tax receipt for every gift, emailed and kept in the donor's account.

In this video:
• Why a fundraising campaign, and how the pieces fit together
• Setting up your receipts: organization, tax ID and statement
• Starting a campaign: goal, suggested amounts, least donation, end date
• How donors give, and name someone to honor
• Donations as orders, and refunds
• What a donor sees: Donations and receipts in their account
• Use cases
